title: Refund status (refunds.status)
caption: Rows written by bookings.cancel, console.bookings.cancel and console.payments.refund; sent by refund.submit on ota-payments (refunds.sweep re-queues lost ones after 5 min); the final state comes from Stripe's webhooks (src/payments/refunds.repository.ts, payment-state.ts REFUND_TRANSITIONS, stripe-events.processor.ts).

states.label: pending
states.detail: Requested; `refund.submit` queued after commit (job id `refund-submit-<rfd_id>`). The customer sees `refund.requested`.

states.label: succeeded
states.detail: Stripe confirmed (`charge.refunded` / `charge.refund.updated`); payment partially_refunded or refunded. Can still turn failed later.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Stripe refused or reported failure (`failure_reason`); staff alert.

states.label: canceled
states.detail: Stripe reported the refund `canceled` (charge.refund.updated); written only from Stripe's word, never by Velexis code itself.

states.label: release recorded
states.detail: Cancellation of an only-authorised Stripe payment: the kept amount is captured and Stripe releases the rest; `recordRelease` inserts the refund row `succeeded` at once (no Stripe refund, `provider_refund_id` empty).

transitions.label: Stripe reports canceled (claim released after a lost answer)
